definitions: An inclined part of a road or railway; a slope.
The degree of inclination of a slope.
The rate of change of a variable quantity with respect to another variable.
A gradual change in the strength of a physical quantity, such as temperature, pressure, or concentration, between two points.
examples: The car struggled up the steep gradient.
The gradient of the hill was challenging.
Calculate the gradient of the line.
There was a temperature gradient across the room.
